gloss: to say the same thing; to say in unison

definitions.gloss: to say the same thing; to agree unanimously; to say in unison
definitions.explanation: Of several people: to say the same thing, either all at once or each separately when asked.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{口|くち}を{揃|そろ}えて「はい」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口|くち}を{揃|そろ}えて⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{褒|ほ}めた→褒める：01204_homeru⟧。
examples.english: The guests all praised the food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口|くち}を{揃|そろ}えて、⟦{真面目|まじめ}→真面目：01206_majime⟧で⟦{優|やさ}しい→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だった⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: Everyone who knew him says the same thing: he was earnest and kind.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always in the て-form before a verb of saying: {口|くち}を{揃|そろ}えて⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ / ⟦{褒|ほ}める→褒める：01204_homeru⟧ / ⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧. Common in news reports quoting several witnesses or experts who agree.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{異口同音|いくどうおん}→異口同音：05666_ikudouon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in unison, with one voice (a four-character compound, more formal).
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: to speak or sing in chorus, literally at the same moment.
